newsitem.title: UK: No sign UK economy in uncontrolled boom - Major.
newsitem.headline: No sign UK economy in uncontrolled boom - Major.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major on Wednesday said there was no sign the country's economy was in an uncontrolled boom.
He also told BBC radio that he saw no sign that inflation was getting out of hand.
"There is no sign that there is an uncontrolled boom. I've made it clear right the way through recent years that we were not going to artificially stimulate the economy to produce a boom," he said.
"We have taken the matter very steadily so that this economy is growing...and growing in a steady and sustainable fashion...

"We look as though we are set fair for trend growth, or above-trend growth, for some years to come and there is no sign on this occasion of inflation getting out of hand which is what has happened on previous occasions," he said.
Major was speaking just before the ruling Conservative party was due to release its manifesto for the May 1 election. It trails the opposition Labour party by a wide margin.
